verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA's developer portal serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200), and several developer docs are available as .md pages (Video Codec SDK, cuML, cuDF, CUDA-X), so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs for the RTX PRO 6000 software stack. Coverage is uneven: the CUDA Toolkit .md variant returns 404, and the llms.txt is portal-wide rather than specific to this GPU. Missing for 10: product-specific agent-oriented docs for the RTX PRO 6000, consistent .md coverage (e.g. CUDA Toolkit), and hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.nvidia.com/llms.txt # NVIDIA Developer
cuML includes an API (cuml.accel) that can run your existing scikit-learn, UMAP, or HDBSCAN code on GPUs with no code modifications.
